name: THE STOVE MAN
note: A STORY ANCHOR, not a fourth drinker: the man who has not taken his coat off since Thad arrived in this territory. MOVED TO THE BACK OF THE ROOM (Tyler, 2026-09-12): at 1145,508 he read as standing at the card table's depth, warming his hands beside the players, and the owner ruled that wrong. He now stands at 1142,438 -- on the painted floor beside the stove, whose own base line is y 412, and 70 to 160 px BEHIND the card group's chairs. THE WALKABLE FLOOR'S FAR EDGE IS NOT THE BACK OF THE ROOM. It is where THAD may stand, and this man is staging, not a navigation target: he has no tree, no barks and no approach. The room's curve reaches zero at its own horizon of y 239, so continuing it above the band is the same perspective rather than a second model, and it draws him 169 px here against 227 at the band's far edge. He is smaller because he is further away. His hands still open toward the iron and its lit firebox, which stay visible past his left shoulder -- the A/B/C study of 2026-09-11 moved him LEFT toward the stove and proved that covers the fire he is warming himself at, so the answer was depth, not sideways.
poseNote: STANDING just off the stove's right side and overlapping it, turned INTO it, both hands open at chest height toward the iron, coat buttoned to the throat.

sprite.note: PHASE 2A: one frame, and that is the phase, not an omission. Static staging first, and Tyler accepts the face in the room before any life is animated on it -- doc 36 Q128. The sheet is pre-scaled to the height this room asks for where the character stands, so the engine draws it at about 1:1 instead of shrinking a 1200 px painting on every frame.

barksNote: NONE. These nine are the room's population, not its dialogue: doc 07's reputation barks belong to the named ambient cast, and nothing in Tyler's Phase 2A ruling gives a generic patron a line. No written content is invented for them here or anywhere.
